### 整合包 查看所有整合包请点击[此处](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=69806)。 ![横幅](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_discord.webp) 获得回复的最佳且最快的方式是加入我们的 [Discord 服务器](https://discord.gg/S5nffJbuvA)。 [![BHsponser](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MMV_Moogs_Missing_Villages/MP_MMV_MoogsMissingVillages_promo.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/moogsmods?r=mrmmv)
